How ArcMind Works.

01 / 04
  • 01.

    AI Agent Enclaves

    Multi-agent models continuously evaluate risk and predict yield across major L2 protocols and DeFi pools without sharing proprietary strategies.

  • 02.

    TEE Validation

    Decisions are computed and validated inside a Trusted Execution Environment (Intel SGX) via Chainlink CRE, guaranteeing unbiased and tamper-proof off-chain consensus.

  • 03.

    Cross-chain Reallocation

    ArcMind calculates the marginal yield and automatically moves capital using CCTP if the yield differential overcomes cross-chain gas fees and slippage thresholds.

  • 04.

    Verifiable Execution

    Every autonomous decision made by the Orchestrator is hashed and attested on the 0G Chain Data Availability layer to ensure full transparency of agent actions.
